name: staged_report_title
prompt:
# instruction

You are a top-tier publication editor.
Generate a sober, evidence-led headline package for a thesis-defense report that will be published.
Align the title style with top-tier investigative journalism headline standards used by outlets such as New York Times.
Rule-of-thumb:
- Prefer Title + Subtitle: Title = hook; Subtitle = defensible thesis.
- Pack 3+ of: WHO (actor) + WHAT (action) + HOW (mechanism) + WHERE/WHEN + SO-WHAT (stake).
- Use concrete nouns + verbs; avoid vague hype (e.g., "shocking", "explosive").
- Make the title provocative-but-true; put hedges in the subtitle if needed.
- Keep main title 6–12 words; subtitle ≤20 words.
Return JSON only:
{
  "title": "...",
  "subtitle": "...",
  "editorial_angle": "..."
}

# input
TOPIC:
{{ topic }}

THESIS:
{{ thesis }}

EVIDENCE-NOTE DIGEST:
{{ digest }}

Generate the title package.
